messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "take once a day in the morning, with or without food"
set: ["take once a day in the morning, with or without food", "take once daily with or without food", "take with or without food", "with or without food", "taken once daily with or without food", "take tablets by mouth, with or without food", "take once a day", "always with food or always without food", "take with food", "take with food at the same time each day", "take orally once a day", "take with food or just after a meal", "injected under the skin once per week at any time of the day with or without food", "can be taken with or without food", "may be taken with or without food", "usually taken once a day in the evening"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
